text:
deploy-bot: publish failed for account 123456789012/eu-west-1 - image redwood/api:2026.03.21-rc1

deploy-bot: error from ECR push: AssumeRoleTokenExpired when calling AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity

sylvia: seeing identical failures in CI, canary didnt update the new image

nate: looking into logs, looks like STS token refresh race between publish workers; may be edge case with short-lived web identity tokens

priya: we are inside the 09:00-11:00 change window, release-manager requested a hold until we understand impact

jay: would prefer to pin canary to previous digest and promote instead of retrying blind

nate: pasted relevant log snippet:
```
2026-03-21T09:20:12Z ERROR deploy/publisher.go:142 AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity failed: AssumeRoleTokenExpired: The provided web identity token has expired
	status code: 403, request id: 6a1f3c2b-xxxx-xxxx
```

leah: deploy-bot has a retry loop but it's backing off because STS returns a hard failure; looks like refresh token never arrived to the worker

release-manager: hold all scheduled canary rollouts for 1h :warning: — do not promote to prod until safety checks pass

priya: updating release notes draft: "Canary hold due to ECR publish failure (IAM token expiry). Manual pin/retag applied to staging; monitoring in progress."

sylvia: can we pin to digest `sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f...` and force-pull in staging? @nate

nate: yes, I'll push a manual retag to that digest and queue a promote job; will also tag metadata with `manual-pin/20260321`

jay: +1 — manual pin avoids re-running CI publishes until we fix STS refresh logic

deploy-bot: manual retag request queued (requested_by: nate) — job id rb-20260321-77

oncall-bot: created incident INC-20260321-001 (ECR publish failures, STS token expiry)

release-manager: schedule a 30m verification window after retag, notify support/sales of potential delay

priya: pinged #support and docs to delay public release notes publish until we confirm promote outcome

leah: filing follow-up ticket to add auto-refresh and stronger visibility when deploy-bot lacks a fresh web-identity token (INFRA-5634)

nate: retag pushed to staging, running smoke tests now

sylvia: staging pulled the pinned digest and smoke tests look green so far :thumbsup:

release-manager: if no regressions in 30m, we promote to prod. Otherwise rollback to previous stable release as per rollback playbook

priya: adding the manual-pin entry to release notes and changelog draft

deploy-bot: promote triggered by nate at 1767813000 (job id pr-20260321-09)

release-manager: leaving thread open for final confirmation and postmortem notes
